root_cause: ZipFile does not own an explicitly supplied BytesIO. Both ZIP input capture and export previously left the external buffer open and relied on garbage collection, including exceptions and work continuing after caller cancellation.
changes: Own the ZIP input BytesIO in an outer context before constructing the archive
Validate exports before allocating output; own output until archive finalization and getvalue complete
Preserve exact file bytes, entry order, fixed timestamps/permissions and DEFLATE parameters
Keep shielded actual task admission, slot counts, close behavior, limits and business error mapping unchanged

coverage: Eleven input cases retain real buffers, archives and member streams strongly; cover successful capture, ZIP construction failure, first/second open/read failure, metadata/document/package validation failure and archive finalization failure
Six export cases cover success, construction, first/second write, getvalue and finalization errors, preserving original OSError identity
One export control proves validation happens before output allocation and the original business error survives
Two event-gated real codec threads continue after waiter cancellation, retain actual pending ownership through close(0), then close resources after single actual parse/export completion
Two uninstrumented real STORED/DEFLATED roundtrips preserve exact package files and metadata, ZIP member order, fixed timestamp/permissions and export compression
Existing ZIP corruption and actual SQLite/HTTP skill import/export, review, model approval, cancellation, lifecycle and architecture callers

isolation: Clean base archive plus only owned files and existing dependencies via isolated interpreter. Real generated ZIPs/BytesIO, strong resource references and faults patched only into this adapter; no global io/zipfile patches. Deterministic thread barriers with bounded test cleanup. Final new test bytes are identical in the old-source negative run and candidate. No full suite, production timeout changes, network or real models; concurrent uncommitted bodies excluded.
not_verified: Real model skill quality, platform deployment and long-running V2 acceptance
Native or whole-process peak memory and cleanup after abrupt interpreter termination
